Customs

การตรวจสอบสินค้า

The physical inspection or testing of cargo by customs or border authorities to ensure contents match declaration and meet regulatory, safety, or security standards.

Quick answer: The physical inspection or testing of cargo by customs or border authorities to ensure contents match declaration and meet regulatory, safety, or security standards.

Quick answer

The physical inspection or testing of cargo by customs or border authorities to ensure contents match declaration and meet regulatory, safety, or security standards.

Why it matters

การตรวจสอบสินค้า matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is การตรวจสอบสินค้า?

In this glossary, การตรวจสอบสินค้า refers to: The physical inspection or testing of cargo by customs or border authorities to ensure contents match declaration and meet regulatory, safety, or security standards.

How is การตรวจสอบสินค้า used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "การตรวจสอบสินค้าพบรายการที่ไม่ได้แจ้ง ส่งผลให้ต้องเสียค่าธรรมเนียมและค่าปรับเพิ่มเติม"

Why does การตรวจสอบสินค้า matter in logistics?

การตรวจสอบสินค้า matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses การตรวจสอบสินค้า?

การตรวจสอบสินค้า is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does การตรวจสอบสินค้า belong to?

In this glossary, การตรวจสอบสินค้า is grouped under Customs. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The physical inspection or testing of cargo by customs or border authorities to ensure contents match declaration and meet regulatory, safety, or security standards.

Operational example

Cargo examination revealed undeclared items in the shipment, resulting in additional duties and penalties.
